app.intro.overview: Live KPIs, flow and findings for the active scenario.

app.scenario.label: Scenario
app.scenario.branchHint: Switching the branch changes every number below. Run Check after a model change to refresh the charts and tables.
app.scenario.baseHint: The protected base is the bundled starting point. Named scenarios keep independent copies; activating one clears stale artifacts until Check runs again.
app.empty.tablesHint: Run Check to generate the artifacts, then the tables appear here.
app.empty.artifactsHint: Run Check to generate the reports for this tool.
app.model.formHint: Fields suggest catalog values but accept custom entries. Every save creates a version in the active scenario.
app.model.yamlHint: Edit the YAML directly, then Save. Every save creates a version; Check regenerates the artifacts.
app.model.yamlGuide.beforeSave: Edit a YAML file below, then select
app.model.yamlGuide.afterReset: to restore the bundled example as a starting template.
app.outputs.hint: Greyed-out artifacts have not been produced for this scenario yet — run Check first. Markdown reports and Mermaid graphs sit alongside machine-readable JSON status.
app.schemas.hint: Each schema maps to one model file. Required fields, enums and bounds are defined here; catalog values are suggestions, not limits.
